sections.content: When visiting someone's home in Hungary, it is customary to bring flowers or wine, and to ask if you should take off your shoes (*levegyem a cipőmet?*). Hosts offer refreshments immediately: *Kértek tőlünk egy kávét?* (Would you like a coffee from us?).

items.english: We are very glad that you came over to our place!
Make yourselves at home at our place!
